annotations.title: Audit who controls a business online

description: Map who controls each layer of a business’s web presence and how hard each would be to leave, from public data only: domain registration over RDAP (registrar, registrant when public, EPP status and transfer locks, expiry, DNSSEC), DNS host from the nameservers, website platform from public fingerprints (Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, GoDaddy Website Builder, Duda, HighLevel, Framer, agency and franchise builders and others), email provider from MX and SPF, analytics and ad tag IDs present in the page (GA4, Tag Manager, Google Ads, Meta Pixel and others), call tracking, embedded booking, CRM, chat and email signup tools, and profile links including a Google Business Profile when supplied. Returns an ownership map with, per layer, who controls it, a portability rating, a plain-words reason, evidence, sources and the first step to take control, plus a 0 to 100 portability score. It cannot see inside any account, so ownership of a Google Business Profile or tag account is reported as a check to make, never guessed. Results are cached for 24 hours.

business_name.description: The business’s legal or trading name. When given, it is compared with the registrant shown in the public domain record.

domain.description: The business domain or website address, such as example.com or https://www.example.com/. Public names only.

profile_urls.description: Links to the business’s profiles, such as its Google Business Profile or Maps link, Facebook page, Instagram or Yelp page. They are classified, not fetched.
